thresholds._min_earth_coverage: If less than 50% of the usable weight has Earth data, the site is 'Cannot be evaluated'.

special_rules._comment: If an Earth site has NO perennial ground ice (ice_presence 0 = none or 1 = seasonal frost only), its depth-to-ice is 'not applicable' and counts as a full mismatch (similarity 0), not as missing data.

slope_200m_deg.note: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not landing safety: NASA's <15° limit is at 1–5 m. Median elevation -3948 m. ~43.33°N, 198.52°E (= −161.48°). Design reference only; landing site not selected. The DEM stores whole metres, so roughness below ~0.5 m is near the quantisation limit.

provenance.dataset: Mars MGS MOLA – MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200 m v2 (USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2018)
provenance.date_range: MGS MOLA (1997–2001) + Mars Express HRSC strips; exact HRSC dates: see product page
provenance.processing: Windowed read of the global 200 m blend; average-resampled to a 200 m local azimuthal-equidistant grid (Mars sphere R=3396190 m) ±5000 m around 43.33, -161.48; slope = arctan|∇z|; roughness = std of 3×3 residuals after removing the local plane; median of window

roughness_200m_m.note: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not landing safety: NASA's <15° limit is at 1–5 m. Median elevation -3948 m. ~43.33°N, 198.52°E (= −161.48°). regolith_type.note: Smooth at large scale, hummocky up close; texture linked to ground ice.

ice_presence.note: Arcadia Planitia: widespread excess ice layer (radar + terraced craters).

ice_depth_m.note: SkyFall GPR depth range: an analog should have ice within this depth.

geologic_unit.note: Geologic map unit (age + landform), NOT a rock type; geology_type stays empty until the team maps units to rock types.

slope_200m_deg.note: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not landing safety: NASA's <15° limit is at 1–5 m. Median elevation -3640 m. Centre of HiRISE ESP_045159_2200 (~39.64°N, 190.42°E), not a region centre. The DEM stores whole metres, so roughness below ~0.5 m is near the quantisation limit.

provenance.dataset: Mars MGS MOLA – MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200 m v2 (USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2018)
provenance.date_range: MGS MOLA (1997–2001) + Mars Express HRSC strips; exact HRSC dates: see product page
provenance.processing: Windowed read of the global 200 m blend; average-resampled to a 200 m local azimuthal-equidistant grid (Mars sphere R=3396190 m) ±5000 m around 39.64, -169.58; slope = arctan|∇z|; roughness = std of 3×3 residuals after removing the local plane; median of window

roughness_200m_m.note: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not landing safety: NASA's <15° limit is at 1–5 m. Median elevation -3640 m. Centre of HiRISE ESP_045159_2200 (~39.64°N, 190.42°E), not a region centre. The DEM stores whole metres, so roughness below ~0.5 m is near the quantisation limit.

provenance.dataset: Mars MGS MOLA – MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200 m v2 (USGS Astrogeology; Fergason et al. 2018)
provenance.date_range: MGS MOLA (1997–2001) + Mars Express HRSC strips; exact HRSC dates: see product page
provenance.processing: Windowed read of the global 200 m blend; average-resampled to a 200 m local azimuthal-equidistant grid (Mars sphere R=3396190 m) ±5000 m around 39.64, -169.58; slope = arctan|∇z|; roughness = std of 3×3 residuals after removing the local plane; median of window

temp_range_K.note: No region values in team docs. MEDA data is from Jezero (18°N), not these regions.

ice_presence.note: Smooth mantle, polygons and secondary craters suggest shallow ice; lobate debris aprons.

ice_depth_m.note: SkyFall GPR depth range: an analog should have ice within this depth.

geologic_unit.value: HNt Hesperian and Noachian transition unit 100%
geologic_unit.note: Geologic map unit (age + landform), NOT a rock type; geology_type stays empty until the team maps units to rock types.

provenance.dataset: USGS SIM 3292 Geologic Map of Mars, 1:20M (Tanaka et al. 2014)
provenance.processing: Point-in-polygon on a 1 km grid within 5 km of 39.64, -169.58; units with ≥10% of the samples, largest first
